hook.hf_equivalent: GPT2Model hidden_states[8] = input to transformer.h[8]; edits via forward pre-hook on transformer.h[8]
hook.coordinates: TransformerLens with center_writing_weights=True centres W_E, W_pos, W_O, b_O, W_out, b_out (TransformerLens@24b039f25d4439db8d34e26d95358b62d6fb1a1d transformer_lens/weight_processing.py center_writing_weights, lines 1176-1384). DERIVATION (not executed): x_TL = h_HF - mean_d(h_HF). Edits are defined in TL coordinates: the SAE reads x_TL + delta; the model is run on h_HF + delta (LayerNorm removes the mean component, so downstream logits match TL up to a per-position constant).
hook.caveat: The TransformerLens version used when the SAE was trained is not recorded in cfg.json; centering behaviour was verified only at TL HEAD 24b039f. Checked empirically by contract checks C3/C4 below (NOT_RUN).
